objective: Select the next measurement or improvement goal after closing the paged-attention/KV-cache repeat-median public benchmark pack boundary.

decision.reason: The repeat-median public pack is closed, while the roadmap's weakest point is still validation breadth for generated config and generic host-probe metadata. This improves the Verilator-like hybrid flow without importing untracked candidate overlays or broadening workload claims.

candidate_review.name: config_generation_validation_breadth
candidate_review.reason: It directly attacks the remaining usability blocker: proving generated clock/reset/template metadata and generic host-probe build behavior across more tracked target shapes.

candidate_review.name: paged_attention_kv_cache_scale_up_continuation
candidate_review.reason: The current four-shape paged-attention/KV-cache set already has correctness, timing, repeat-median review, and public-pack closure; larger shapes should wait until the generated-config path is less target-specific.

candidate_review.name: resident_execution_optimization
candidate_review.reason: Resident optimization is valuable, but tuning launch/runtime behavior before broadening config-generation validation would hide the remaining operator-simplicity blocker.

candidate_review.name: quantized_kv_cache_boundary
candidate_review.reason: Quantized KV-cache candidates are outside the current tracked review boundary and should not be promoted through this selection-only gate.

candidate_review.name: full_ita_mha_additional_shapes
candidate_review.reason: Additional MHA shapes broaden measurement coverage, but they do not first resolve the generic generated-config/host-probe validation gap.
